# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| capital-request-package | `assets/capital-request-package.md`, filled | Human who submits, approvers named in the approval matrix | Complete or its gaps are named with a role who closes them; The ask in one line (amount, what it buys, phase, decision date); Route and approver written next to the amount; Tracked and proven euros shown separately, never summed; Options include a smaller version and do-nothing |
| management-summary-deck | Deck from the eCR builder; last slide Open items and conflicts | Human who submits | Every figure carries its grounding chip; Closed with one maturity verdict (Ready to sign, Sign the floor, or Not ready) |
| gate-dependency-on-use-case-and-saving-r | Dependency entry (`ECR CREATION`, then `ECR APPROVAL` once filed) with owner | DBVE (owns the savings ledger) | Recorded on the use case and on each affected saving row; Updated with the outcome after the decision |
| refusal-with-de-risk-questions | Reply listing the de-risk questions, instead of a package | Requester | Issued when the value backbone, investment estimate or assessment verdict is missing or too thin; No package is produced |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| capital-request-package | structure of `assets/capital-request-package.md` | Human who submits |
| management-summary-deck | manual | Human who submits |
| gate-dependency-on-use-case-and-saving-r | manual | DBVE (owns the savings ledger) |
| refusal-with-de-risk-questions | manual | Requester |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `bc-build`, `bc-cost`, `bc-assess`, `funnel-prototype`, `dept-decision-rights`, `funnel-evaluation`
- **Next:** the human approvers decide, then deploy-handover (step 26) and the build.: `deploy-handover`
- **Next:** Other gates the spend touches: OpenSpec IT demand (external), deploy-cybersec.: `deploy-cybersec`
- **Stops here when:** no money needs committing (record that and stop), the value backbone, estimate or verdict is missing (refusal gate), or the package has been handed to a human to review and submit
